name: Miahona Co.
summary: Miahona Company Limited, headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specializes in the development of crucial water and wastewater infrastructure. The firm's extensive operations encompass the entire water cycle, from the production, transportation, and distribution of water, including the construction, operation, and maintenance of desalination plants and water supply networks, to drilling various water wells and advancing water technology for reuse. In the realm of sanitation, Miahona builds, operates, and maintains sophisticated sewer systems, wastewater treatment facilities, disposal plants, and pumping stations. This also includes the comprehensive management of wastewater collection, treatment, recycling, and disposal. Beyond its core water and sewage services, the company undertakes a wide array of infrastructure and construction projects. This involves constructing non-residential buildings like schools, hospitals, and hotels, developing and managing industrial cities, and establishing and operating electricity generation stations. Miahona also builds and maintains torrents networks and general utility projects. Its capabilities extend to public construction contracting, encompassing piping, electrical, mechanical, maintenance, operation, and road works. Additionally, the company engages in land acquisition for development and real estate investment through property sales and rentals. Founded in 2008, Miahona Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Vision International Investment Company.
